title: Secret Field Type
description: Schema for a secret input: the value is stored in the secret manager through the setSecret mutation and the form keeps only a ${secret:<name>} reference (e.g. API keys, SMTP passwords)

placeholder.description: Placeholder shown while entering a new secret value

secretPath.description: Secret name passed to setSecret (template expressions allowed). The backend prefixes it with the organization, so use a stable path such as '<configName>/<key>'

onChange.description: Actions to execute after the secret reference changes
